paragraphs.text: He shows the excellency and authority that this tribe had above all the rest.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He made a king of his tribe.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The Ephraimites are not far from destruction, and have lost their authority.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: "Let the men that sacrifice" or "while they sacrifice men". The false prophets persuaded the idolaters to offer their children after the example of Abraham, and he shows how they would exhort one another to the same, and to kiss and worship these calves which were their idols.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: Let the men that sacrifice kiss

paragraphs.text: He calls them to repentance, and reproves their ingratitude.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Your destruction is certain, and my benefits toward you declare that it comes not from me: therefore your own malice, idolatry, and vain confidence in men must necessarily be the cause of it.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: It is surely laid up to be punished, as in Jer 17:1.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: But would come out of the womb, that is out of these dangers in which he is, and not wait to be suppressed.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Meaning that no power will resist God when he will deliver his own, but even in death he will give them life.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Because they will not turn to me, I will change my purpose.
paragraphs.label: l
paragraphs.anchor: repentance shall be hid from mine
